## Schedule {.unnumbered #schedule}

The topics and dates of future lectures may change.
The [course calendar](calendar.qmd) gives the day-by-day agenda,
including every deadline;
the table below gives the topics and readings week by week.
Readings are sections of Epp's *Discrete Mathematics with Applications* (5th ed.), which is recommended, not required.
Classes begin on Tuesday, January 5,
so the first lecture is on Wednesday, January 6.
Monday, January 18 (Martin Luther King Jr. Day)
and Monday, February 15 (Presidents' Day)
are university holidays, with no class.

| Week | Dates | Topics | Assigned work | Reading |
|:-----|:------|:-------|:------------|:--------|
| 1 | Jan 5--8 | Introduction to [functional programming](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/chapters/functional-programming.html); [propositional logic](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/chapters/propositional-logic.html), [predicates and quantifiers](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/chapters/predicates-quantifiers.html), [logical equivalence and negation](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/chapters/equivalence-negation.html) | Quiz 0; Lab 1 | 1.1, 2.1--2.3, 3.1 |
| 2 | Jan 11--15 | Proofs: [inference and direct proof](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/chapters/direct-proof.html), [contrapositive, and contradiction](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/chapters/contrapositive-contradiction.html) | Lab 2; Homework 1 | 4.1--4.2, 4.4 |
| 3 | Jan 18--22 | Proofs, continued; sets and functions | Lab 3; Homework 2 | 1.2--1.3, 4.7--4.8 |
| 4 | Jan 25--29 | Mathematical induction; loop invariants | **Midterm 1**, Wednesday, Jan 27 | 5.1--5.2 |
| 5 | Feb 1--5 | Induction, continued; recurrence relations | Lab 4; Homework 3 | 5.4--5.6 |
| 6 | Feb 8--12 | Growth rates of functions (big-O and asymptotic notation) | Lab 5; Homework 4 | 11.2--11.3 |
| 7 | Feb 15--19 | Relations; graphs: paths, cycles, and connectivity | **Midterm 2**, Wednesday, Feb 17 | 1.4, 8.1--8.3, 10.1 |
| 8 | Feb 22--26 | Graphs: breadth-first and depth-first traversal | Lab 6; Homework 5 | 10.1, 10.3, class notes |
| 9 | Mar 1--5 | State machines and finite automata | Lab 7; Homework 6 | 12.2 |
| 10 | Mar 8--12 | Trees and their traversal | Lab 8 | 10.4--10.6 |
| Finals | Mar 15--19 | | **Final exam**: Tuesday, Mar 16 (CRNs 13745, 13746) or Thursday, Mar 18 (CRNs 13747, 13748), 10:30am--12:30pm | |

The midterm dates are tentative.
If a midterm's date changes, I will announce the change
at least two weeks before that exam is given.
